title: Shared costs
bodyMd: Two divisions use a central laboratory. Its annual building lease is fixed regardless of how many tests the divisions request. Finance allocates the lease cost in proportion to tests performed. One division proposes requesting fewer tests to reduce its allocated cost. The laboratory manager explains that this could change the division’s reported figure without reducing the company’s lease payment.
